All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Security update for qemu", "title": "Title of the patch"}, {"category": "description", "text": "This update for qemu fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-81627: missing writable RAM alias validation in the VAPIC setup hypercall allows a privileged guest user to
  bypass chipset `D_LCK` protection and injecting code into System Management Mode memory (bsc#1282077).
- CVE-2026-93834: hw/9pfs: mutate FID path from main thread only (bsc#1282578).

Changes for qemu:

- Bugfixes:
 * [openSUSE][RPM] spec: drop qemu-ipxe Requires for ppc (bsc#1282918)
 * virtio: fix queue size validation against allocated maximum (bsc#1279962)
 * virtio-mmio: fix QUEUE_NUM_MAX (bsc#1279962)
 * target/ppc/kvm: Use host compatibility mode for nested guests (bsc#1263864)
 * target/ppc/kvm: Add support for querying host compatibility mode (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Update to include KVM_CAP_PPC_COMPAT_CAPS (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Update to Linux v7.2-rc1 with KVM_S390_VM_CPU_FEAT_ASTFLEIE2 (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Update to Linux v7.1-rc4 (bsc#1263864)
 * scripts/update-linux-headers: Add typelimits.h (bsc#1263864)
 * update-linux-headers: Inject VIRTIO_RING_NO_LEGACY in virtio_ring.h (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Add nitro_enclaves.h (bsc#1263864)
 * scripts/update-linux-headers: Add Nitro Enclaves header (bsc#1263864)
 * standard-headers: Update virtio_spi.h from Linux v6.18-rc3 (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Update to Linux v6.19-rc1 (bsc#1263864)
 * update-linux-headers: Remove "asm-s390/unistd_32.h" (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Update to Linux v6.18-rc3 (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers/linux: Add mshv.h headers (bsc#1263864)
 * include/hw/hyperv: Add MSHV ABI header definitions (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Update to Linux v6.17-rc1 (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: deal with counted_by annotation (bsc#1263864)
 * linux-headers: Remove the 32-bit arm headers (bsc#1263864)
 * update Linux headers to KVM tree master (bsc#1263864)
